mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_post_count (post_id, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count) VALUES (#{postId}, #{likeCount}, 0, 0) ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET like_count = EXCLUDED.like_count, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO tb_post_count (post_id, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count) VALUES (#{postId}, 0, #{favoriteCount}, 0) ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET favorite_count = EXCLUDED.favorite_count, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: WITH batch AS ( SELECT id AS post_id FROM tb_post WHERE id > #{afterId} AND id <= #{untilId} ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO tb_post_count (post_id, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count) SELECT b.post_id, COALESCE(lk.cnt, 0), COALESCE(fv.cnt, 0), COALESCE(cm.cnt, 0) FROM batch b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM tb_thumb WHERE post_id > #{afterId} AND post_id <= #{untilId} GROUP BY post_id ) lk ON lk.post_id = b.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM tb_favorite WHERE post_id > #{afterId} AND post_id <= #{untilId} GROUP BY post_id ) fv ON fv.post_id = b.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM tb_comment WHERE deleted = 0 AND post_id > #{afterId} AND post_id <= #{untilId} GROUP BY post_id ) cm ON cm.post_id = b.post_id ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET like_count = EXCLUDED.like_count, favorite_count = EXCLUDED.favorite_count, comment_count = EXCLUDED.comment_count, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tb_post_count.like_count IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.like_count OR tb_post_count.favorite_count IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.favorite_count OR tb_post_count.comment_count IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.comment_count RETURNING post_id, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count ) SELECT post_id AS postId, like_count AS likeCount, favorite_count AS favoriteCount, comment_count AS commentCount FROM upserted
